reviews.author: Sana Malik
reviews.text: Bilkul waisay hi aaya jaisay picture mein tha. Fabric bohot soft hai aur stitching perfect. Zaroor dobara order karoungi!

reviews.author: Zainab A.
reviews.text: Shadi mein pehna aur sab ne taarif ki. Quality ekdam top class hai. Delivery bhi time pe aai.

reviews.author: Nida R.
reviews.text: Bahut acha suit hai, fabric aur color dono achi quality ke hain. Custom stitching option ke liye shukriya.
